items.question: Backfill scope for a git-tracked decisions register. Measured: full = 768 decision rows in 119 docs (92K tokens of rows, 2-3 seat sessions); living docs = 366 rows in 56 docs (1-2 sessions); ratchet = open decisions only (under 1 session).

options.label: (a)
options.text: ratchet: open decisions only, add ruled rows when their doc is touched

options.label: (c)->(b)
options.text: living docs first, then the remaining rows in the next session, ending at (b)

items.rationale: Ends at the full record (b). Doing the living docs first protects the docs seats cite this month soonest; the extra cost of (b) over (c) is about one session.
